headline: Kiku Chiranjeevi is now streaming on aha: OTT release date and where to watch
dek: The Telugu film, starring Kiku Yanamala, Kashish Khan, Easwari Rao, arrived on aha 78 days after opening in cinemas on 28 August.
paragraphs: Kiku Chiranjeevi is streaming on aha in India from 14 November.
That is 78 days after its theatrical release on 28 August — 50 days slower than the typical 28 days for Telugu films, based on 14 recent releases tracked by New on OTT.

A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.
Directed by Shubha Sai Venkat, starring Kiku Yanamala, Kashish Khan, Easwari Rao, Tanikella Bharani, Goparaju Ramana. The film is certified A.
New on OTT re-checks aha's India listing every day; the page for Kiku Chiranjeevi has the latest on where to watch it.
